tasks.title: Implement Phase 8: GitHub Issue Sync Engine (Bi-directional)
tasks.description: Build bi-directional sync between GitHub Issues and internal COE tasks. When issues are created/updated, auto-generate tasks. When tasks complete, update/close issues. Maintain labels, milestones, assignees in sync.
tasks.details: AI Prompt: Implement GitHub issue webhooks (using HMAC verification per Phase 4 pattern). On issue create/update: extract title/body → generate structured tasks with dependencies and context bundles. On task completion: update issue status, add completion comment, close if milestone done. Sync assignees (GitHub users → internal agents). Handle sub-issues as subtasks. Output: Working webhook receiver, task generator, issue updater; tested with real GitHub events.",
tasks.testStrategy: 1) Create test issue on GitHub → verify task auto-generated in _ZENTASKS. 2) Complete task → verify GitHub issue gets comment + closed. 3) Test label/milestone sync. 4) Validate HMAC signature rejection for invalid payloads.

tasks.title: Implement Phase 9a: Safe Branching & Merge Validation
tasks.description: Implement safe branching strategy (feature/hotfix/release/integration branches), automated branch isolation, merge validation via tests + architecture checks, and stale branch cleanup.
tasks.details: AI Prompt: Create branch management service that: 1) Names branches per scheme (feature/issue-{id}, hotfix/*, release/*). 2) Instructs Copilot to create branches for tasks. 3) Runs test suite + architecture validation before merge (use existing Phase 1-3 services). 4) Detects stale branches (no commits >30d + CI passing). 5) Instructs Copilot to delete stale branches with confirmation. Output: Branch manager service, merge gate API, stale detector; tested in staging repo.",
tasks.testStrategy: 1) Create feature branch for task; verify naming. 2) Push breaking change → verify merge blocked. 3) Fix + re-push → verify merge allowed. 4) Create stale branch → run cleanup → verify identified and deleted (with user confirm).

tasks.title: Implement Phase 10a: Repository Health Monitoring & Auto-Maintenance
tasks.description: Monitor repository health (commit frequency, test coverage, dependency freshness, CI/CD stability). Detect drift and auto-generate maintenance tasks. Support continuous coding framework.
tasks.details: AI Prompt: Build health monitor service that: 1) Queries commits, tests, CI logs; calculates health scores. 2) Detects version drift (dependencies, Node, PHP versions). 3) Flags security issues (CVE scanning). 4) Tracks coverage trends. 5) Generates maintenance tasks for drift (e.g., 'Update lodash 4.17.20 → 4.17.21 [SEC]'). 6) Runs on interval (hourly/daily). 7) Integrates with Copilot for auto-fixes. Output: Health monitor service, metrics dashboard data, auto-generated maintenance tasks.",
tasks.testStrategy: 1) Check health on test repo; verify scores calculated. 2) Introduce security issue (old dep); verify detected + task created. 3) Fix and re-check; verify score improved. 4) Validate maintenance task format is executable by Copilot.

tasks.title: Design Phase 7-10: Agent Roles & Integration Architecture
tasks.description: Create guide templates and integration instructions for cloud agents (Claude, GPT-4) and background maintenance agents. Define agent roles, responsibilities, and context requirements per Phase 7+ architecture.
tasks.details: AI Prompt: Document: 1) Cloud Agent roles: Zen Planner (planning), Zen Architect (design), Cloud Coder (complex refactors), Cloud Tester (test generation). 2) Background Agent roles: Health Monitor (polling repo), Dependency Updater (auto-fixes), Branch Cleaner (stale detection). 3) For each role: activation trigger, context bundle contents, expected outputs, success criteria. 4) Integration instructions for adding new agents (API endpoint, auth, context shape). 5) Agent hand-off protocol between extension and external LLMs. Output: Agent roles doc, integration guide, example context bundles, config schema.",
tasks.testStrategy: 1) Review with Zen Planner to validate planning context. 2) Review with Auto Zen to validate execution context. 3) Validate against Phase 7 architecture. 4) Onboard a test agent using the guide; verify successful integration."
